sentences.en: You have tennis elbow. Soak your arm in warm water.
sentences.zh: 你患了网球肘。把胳膊泡在温水里。

sentences.en: It's very warm. Shall I turn on the air conditioner?
sentences.zh: 天气很暖和。要不要开空调？

sentences.en: "I want a house to keep me warm," he said.
sentences.zh: "我想要一所房子来保暖，"他说。

senses.zh: 使…兴奋；使…温暖；使…感兴趣
